<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.

- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.

- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.

## Problem
Garage estimate documents are automatically placed in the wrong category, forcing manual correction. This leads to missed evidence and delays because critical information is overlooked during claims processing.

## Who is affected
- Five customer accounts are affected, representing a total ARR of £4,290,000.0 [i:0b669b812359487f][i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:6401b85f53f8e56b].
- The issue has been raised via three different routes: support, account management, and onboarding [i:0b669b812359487f][i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:6401b85f53f8e56b].
- One account, Marrowgate Commercial, has a renewal date of 2026-12-12 [i:6401b85f53f8e56b].

## Evidence
- There have been 13 mentions of this problem across the five accounts [i:0b669b812359487f][i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:6401b85f53f8e56b].
- Eight mentions came through the support route [i:0b669b812359487f][i:27425ffc5bea7e8a][i:6f60a28973334f3b].
- Two mentions came through the account management route [i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:1d02c338591f1b06].
- Three mentions came through the onboarding route [i:6401b85f53f8e56b][i:766f9ca2be319649][i:a918397cecacd89d].
- Saltmarsh Specialty, with an ARR of £740,000.0, stated: "Garage estimates keep landing in correspondence — we have to manually recategorise them, and sometimes evidence gets missed because of it. The incorrect file type assignment is causing real ... delays and oversight risks." [i:0b669b812359487f]
- Linnet House Insurance, with an ARR of £360,000.0, stated: "Every time a garage estimate gets dumped into correspondence, someone has to manually fix it — and sometimes the wrong document category means evidence gets overlooked entirely." [i:0fc6cb6155656fe2]
- Marrowgate Commercial, with an ARR of £1,600,000.0, stated: "Also, when we upload garage estimates, they land under Correspondence — that incorrect file type is causing handlers to manually re-categorise everything." [i:6401b85f53f8e56b]
- Thistlecombe Mutual, with an ARR of £980,000.0, mentioned the issue via account management [i:1d02c338591f1b06].
- Brackwater Homecover, with an ARR of £610,000.0, mentioned the issue via support [i:6f60a28973334f3b].

## Why now
- The issue has been reported consistently, with the most recent mentions in late October 2026 [i:0b669b812359487f][i:6f60a28973334f3b].
- One renewal has occurred in the last 90 days [i:6401b85f53f8e56b].
- Marrowgate Commercial, a key account with an ARR of £1,600,000.0, is due for renewal on 2026-12-12 and has described the problem as causing "delays in handling claims properly" [i:a918397cecacd89d].
</previous_draft>
